causality_tests.failure_condition: Any target at or before the prefix boundary changes.
causality_tests.name: future_truncation
causality_tests.procedure: Remove all later bar and funding rows and compare exact prefix targets.

causality_tests.name: future_corruption
causality_tests.procedure: Append extreme non-finite funding and price rows at or after the decision; causal outputs must remain exact.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Input order changes ranks, sleeves, or bytes.
causality_tests.name: deterministic_rerun
causality_tests.procedure: Reverse symbol, bar, and funding row order and compare exact targets using seed 20260801.

causality_tests.failure_condition: An ineligible symbol, stale funding event, duplicate event/bar, or non-grid substitute enters a feature.
causality_tests.name: availability_membership
causality_tests.procedure: Inject each violation and require exclusion or a fail-closed flat request.

decision_contract.rebalance_rule: integer 8h epoch index modulo 9 equals zero

derived_features.availability: unique funding events in [t-21d,t), with >=18 prior, >=3 recent, and newest age <=16h
derived_features.formula: L=fsum(all rates)/21; P=fsum(prior rates)/18; R=fsum(recent rates)/3; D=R-P
derived_features.missing_rule: no fill; invalid, duplicate, stale, insufficient, or abs(rate)>0.05 excludes the symbol

derived_features.availability: 90 exact 8h returns from 91 closed bars through t-8h
derived_features.missing_rule: every expected positive close is required; no imputation or older anchor

derived_features.availability: current symbols with both valid features; >=30 before and >=24 after filter
derived_features.missing_rule: flat if cross-section, rank, or carry-spread requirements fail

derived_features.availability: finite retained scores at scheduled decision
derived_features.formula: K=max(6,floor(N/4)); top K long, bottom K short; equal B_eff=min(0.20,K*0.03)
derived_features.missing_rule: flat if either sleeve, positive carry spread, cap, gross, or net invariant fails

forbidden_inputs: price return, trend, reversal, path efficiency, residual, or beta as a score
OHLC shape, quote volume, taker flow, or auction absorption
common market, organizer regime label, or direction tilt
execution open, mark price as a feature, fills, position, equity, costs, drawdown, or PnL
private/final observations, other teams, V1 results, ballots, or leaderboards

raw_inputs.coverage: organizer-streamed realized funding for current eligible symbols

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: decision time after causal weekly reconstitution
raw_inputs.coverage: current point-in-time Top-40 intersected with executable symbols
